vectors.name: lint/basic/unsatisfiable-reachable-record-is-a-warning
vectors.comment: reachable is a plain walk following every reference-typed field regardless of cardinality, so Node counts as reached from itself/root even though it's also unsatisfiable -- both facts can be true of the same record.

vectors.name: lint/basic/duplicate-records-are-one-finding-per-block-not-per-name
vectors.comment: A and B are structurally identical. This MUST be exactly one finding naming the sorted block ("A, B"), never one finding per record name -- a previous edition of the ch.6 pseudocode wrongly specified one-per-name, which never matched the reference implementation (Sec6.11's own history note).

vectors.name: lint/basic/any-field-is-informational-not-a-warning
vectors.comment: any-field is advisory only -- it MUST NOT on its own cause ok:false, unlike the three warning-severity finding types above.
